Read ⌈
Service Name
Xxx_ConditionCheckRead
Syntax

Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType* ErrorCode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x49
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
ErrorCode
If the operation Xxx_ConditionCheckRead returns value E_NOT_
OK, the DCM module shall send a negative response with NRC
code equal to the parameter ErrorCode parameter value.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request was successful.
E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful.
